script.spoken: Rana Plaza collapsed with garment workers inside. It crushed thousands of garment workers, and one thousand one hundred thirty four died. Cracks had appeared the day before. Shops on the ground floor closed. But garment workers were ordered back in. The building had extra floors added illegally and stood on weak ground. Heavy generators shook the structure when the power cut out. Independent factory inspections followed across Bangladesh.
